newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania refinancing loans 4.9 pct up in August.
newsitem.headline: Romania refinancing loans 4.9 pct up in August.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) refinancing loans rose by 4.9 percent in August, with soft facilities for farmers soaring to 1.57 trillion lei from July's 1.0 trillion, a BNR report showed on Thursday.

The total daily refinancing was 4.9 trillion lei on average in August. Lombard loans fell to zero after the BNR listed separately credits granted to debtors in dispute at law, which include loans given to troubled banks Dacia Felix SA and Renasterea Creditului Romanesc Credit Bank SA.
The BNR, which kept afloat Dacia Felix and Credit Bank for more than one year after they revealed huge debts and losses, does not charge interest on loans to those debtors.
Courts are expected to rule on their fate -- reorganisation or liquidation.
Auctioned credits slipped to 388.1 billion lei in August from 467.1 billion in July and structural loans saw a 10 percent fall to 969.2 billion lei.
Average annual interest rates charged for each type of BNR's refinancing windows were 35 percent for structural loans and 49.4 percent for one-week funds.
Support for farmers carried an annual 31 percent and Lombard had 90 percent interest. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
